calibration_note: The v0.1.1 score-50 two-week stress budget was economically over-restrictive after company-level per-strategy caps were removed. v0.2 preserves score 50 as neutral policy and maps it to the approximately 18 percent two-week stress budget that restored about 95-99 percent of frozen Directional economics in the boundary counterfactual. Endpoints retain the prior piecewise geometry by a uniform 1.5x rescaling and remain subject to validation gates.
